config.title: Where to See the Berlin TV Tower - FAQ
config.subtitle: Free places outside Mitte to see the Fernsehturm, and the best hour for each one.

items.q: Where can I see the Berlin TV Tower for free?
items.a: From the street almost anywhere, but the best free views outside Mitte are **Karl-Marx-Allee at Frankfurter Tor**, **Warschauer Brücke**, the **Molecule Man from Elsenbrücke**, **Mont Klamott** in Volkspark Friedrichshain and **Tempelhofer Feld**.

items.q: Where is the best place to photograph the TV Tower at sunset?
items.a: **Mont Klamott** in early November, when the sun sets almost behind the tower. **Warschauer Brücke** and the **Molecule Man** from the Treptow end of Elsenbrücke also work well at sunset and into the blue hour.

items.q: Can you see the TV Tower from Karl-Marx-Allee?
items.a: Yes. From **U Frankfurter Tor** the tower stands at the far end of the avenue, about **3 km** west. Morning is best, because the sun is behind you and lights the tower from the front.

items.q: How do I get the Molecule Man and the TV Tower in one photo?
items.a: Stand at the **Treptow end of Elsenbrücke**, a few minutes from S Treptower Park. Right beside the sculpture the two do not line up. The bridge is being rebuilt, so check which footway is open.

items.q: Can you see the TV Tower from Tempelhofer Feld?
items.a: Yes, about **5 km** due north, above the old airport building. The field is free and open **07:00 to 18:00 in November**. A phone zoom or longer lens helps.

No. Teufelsberg costs **EUR 12** for adults, EUR 10 reduced, EUR 5 for under 18s and EUR 27 for a family, free up to age 7. In November it opens **11:00 to 17:00**, last entry 16:00. **Drachenberg** next door is free.

items.q: What time of day is best to see the TV Tower?
items.a: It depends on where you stand. With the sun behind you the tower is lit from the front; with the sun behind the tower you get an outline. **Tempelhofer Feld** works at any hour, **Karl-Marx-Allee** in the morning, the rest at sunset.
